description: This file is the entry point for a React front-end application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React app by rendering the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React node for rendering the React component tree into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the specified DOM node.
